# arcstone-refinement-harness
> Canonical Mechanized Refinement & Simulation Harness for the Arcstone Computational Spine (ACS)
> Master Anchor: A-77-DELTA-SHIELD-LOCKED

## Project Summary
An external, content-addressed verification airlock decoupling upstream bare-metal execution (C_ops = 0) from downstream mechanized proof maintenance (C_ops > 0). Proves one-way forward safety simulation (Rust_Impl ⊑ Coq_Spec) without modifying frozen upstream #[no_std] Rust kernels.

## Core Invariants
- Upstream Drag: C_ops = 0 (Frozen, read-only upstream)
- Memory: M_alloc = 0, S_max <= 4096 Bytes
- Hardware Watchdog: tau_eval <= 10.00 ms, tau_override <= 11.99 ms (NMI Circuit Breaker)
- Continuous Robust Reachability: Rational witness gamma in Q (ADR-009 Bellman-Gronwall residual)
- Poset Dominance Lattice: POSIX 40 > POSIX 32 > POSIX 30 > POSIX 12 > POSIX 10 > POSIX 0

## Core Components
- /AGENTS.md: Operational precedence lattice, zero-upstream-mutation constraints, and retrieval directives.
- /PINS.lock: Cryptographic Git commit SHAs (`d8d8d3870dd8b9f449b445645ec73ca5d0f02e60`), tree SHA-256 (`fcd08cc86d9802f64442ab7162abcf23678900fda692a2427902cbaf05abd3da`), and Zenodo DOIs of pinned upstream repositories.
- /docs/attestations/REFINEMENT-AUDIT-2026-V1.json: Canonical machine-verifiable CI proof receipt (`REFINEMENT-PROOF-CHAIN-CLOSED`, `admitted_axioms: 0`).
- /extract/run_charon.sh: Non-invasive extraction of Low-Level Borrow Calculus (LLBC) from rustc MIR.
- /scripts/run_aeneas.sh: Functional Coq 8.18.0 translation of LLBC.
- /proofs/Refinement.v: Machine-checked forward safety simulation proof (Print Assumptions == ∅).
- /upstream/domain-projection-spec/: Pinned Phase 8 abstract reachability specification.
